content: {"summary":"A stale TLS certificate persisted on one edge‑gateway pod because the pod was never restarted after the secret was renewed, and the daily outside probe did not detect it as it only queried through the load balancer, hitting renewed pods.","likely_cause":"Manual pod‑deletion restart mistake left one pod with the old cert, and the monitoring probe’s load‑balanced check missed the stale pod.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"The daily outside probe only checked renewed pods via the load balancer, so it missed the stale certificate.","evidence_ids":["RB-025#0","INC-0023#1"],"quote":"the daily outside probe kept reporting the new date"},{"text":"One edge‑gateway pod was never restarted after the secret update, keeping the expired cert in memory.","evidence_ids":["INC-0023#1"],"quote":"the original pod behind edge-gateway-01 never was"},{"text":"Envoy loads the certificate only at start, so a pod that isn’t restarted continues serving the old cert.","evidence_ids":["RB-025#0","INC-0023#1"],"quote":"Envoy reads the certificate only at start"}],"next_checks":["Implement a rollout‑restart for all edge‑gateway pods during certificate renewal","Add per‑pod TLS expiry checks to the monitoring probe","Audit that after each secret update all pods serve the new notAfter date"]}
